latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video King AI — Convert Images Into Video Clips.

- Instantly converts still images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 200MB) into animated 1080p MP4 videos with AI-powered rendering, ready for social media.
- No complex setup: upload images, give simple prompts (“turn my photos into a smooth animated video with transitions”), download results.
- Auto cloud connection and authentication; new users get 100 free credits (7-day expiry) with anonymous token support.
- Full support for session management, easy exports, credit/balance checks, and workflow status updates.
- Robust error handling, quick session recovery, and user-friendly event messages throughout the video creation process.
